title: THE UNWIND · BACK RESET + LEG AMRAP
vibe: YELLOW VOLUME · 45 MIN · LOOSEN THE BACK, THEN LEGS
why: Low back tight from the hotel bed, not from training. So a 12-minute back reset leads instead of a 6-minute warm-up, then a lower-body AMRAP built on single-leg work that keeps the spine tall (curtsy, knees-over-toes lunge, lateral walks, rotations) from the muscle-building manual Week 3 Day 4, run legs short and optional. Written at the middle of the range on purpose. Finish with the three spine-stabilizing moves physical therapists use for a cranky back.

blocks.title: BACK RESET · 12 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · slow · breathe out on every stretch · Moves Method Day A spine and hips plus today's back research

items.name: Cat-cow
items.detail: x10, 3 s each way, move one vertebra at a time

items.name: Sphinx to cobra
items.detail: x8, press up slowly, hips stay on the floor, 2 s at the top

items.name: Pelvic tilts (lying)
items.detail: x15, flatten the low back into the floor then release

items.name: Knee-to-chest
items.detail: 30 s/side, then both knees 30 s, pull gently

items.name: 90-90 hip switches
items.detail: x8/side, tall chest, hands off the floor if you can

items.name: Child's pose with side reach
items.detail: 30 s each side, walk the hands to the corner, breathe into the ribs

items.name: Thoracic rotations (quadruped)
items.detail: x8/side, eyes follow the hand

items.name: Active pigeon
items.detail: 45 s/side, press the front shin down

items.name: Single-leg good morning, bodyweight
items.detail: x8/leg, flat back, 5 s pause on the last rep

items.name: Jefferson curl, 10 lb DB
items.detail: x5, 5 s on the way down, stack up slowly

blocks.title: LEG AMRAP · 16:00 · TALL SPINE
blocks.meta: AMRAP 16:00 · target 4 ROUNDS (GREEN 5) · 6 stations in order · chest up on every rep · rest only when form slips

items.name: 1 · Curtsy lunge, 2 x 20 lb
items.detail: x6/side, back foot crosses behind, torso tall, no lean

items.name: 2 · One-bell offset lateral walk, 40 lb
items.detail: WILDCARD · 10 steps each direction, one bell held at the side (the manual's lateral walk), hips level, switch hands at the turn

items.name: 3 · Knees-over-toes reverse lunge, 2 x 20 lb
items.detail: x6/side, front knee travels forward over the toes, heel stays down

items.name: 4 · Standing high-to-low rotation, 15 lb
items.detail: x8/side, bell travels from high outside shoulder to opposite hip, hips turn with it

items.name: 5 · Three-point single-arm row, 30 lb
items.detail: x8/side, one hand on the bench, flat back, elbow to the hip

items.name: 6 · Run leg, 0.20 mi @ 7.5 mph, 1% incline
items.detail: Quick cadence, tall. If the back says no: walk 0.15 mi @ 3.5 mph at 8% instead

blocks.text: Four rounds in 16:00 is the number today. GREEN: five if the back is loose by round 2 and every rep stayed tall. This is a middle-of-the-range card by design: the stimulus is legs that work while the spine stays stacked, not a race. Any station that pinches, drop the bells and do it empty.

blocks.title: SPINE STABILITY CLOSE · 2 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 2 ROUNDS · the physical-therapy big three plus a bridge and a Copenhagen · rest 45 s between rounds

items.name: Bird dog, 3 s holds
items.detail: x6/side, reach long, do not arch, drag the elbow and knee together between reps

items.name: Curl-up, hands under the low back
items.detail: x8, lift only the shoulder blades, 5 s hold each, neutral neck

items.name: Glute bridge march, 3 s holds
items.detail: x6/side, hips high and level, pull one knee up without the pelvis tipping

items.name: Copenhagen hold, knee on the bench
items.detail: 20 s/side, top leg on the bench, bottom knee lifts to meet it, hips tall

blocks.title: COOLDOWN · 4 MIN

items.name: Lying knee-to-chest, both knees
items.detail: 45 s, rock gently side to side

items.name: Supine twist
items.detail: 45 s/side, shoulders flat, breathe out into it

blocks.text: Record rounds completed in 16:00, whether the run legs were run or walked, how the back felt at the start versus the end (1-10), and RPE. Still owed from Wednesday: ladder time or rungs, top rung, sprints held, RPE.
